class.name: GoapAction
class.brief_description: A single step a [GoapAgent] can take towards a [GoapGoal].

method.name: _enter
method.description: Called once when the agent starts this action, after its preconditions have been re-checked. Set up whatever [method _tick] needs here.

method.name: _exit
method.description: Called once when the action stops, whether it succeeded, failed, or was interrupted by [method GoapAgent.abort_plan]. Always paired with a [method _enter] call, so it is the right place to release anything that was reserved there.

method.name: _get_cost
method.description: Called during planning to replace [member cost] with a value computed from the current situation, such as the distance to walk. Negative costs are clamped to [code]0.0[/code]. This runs once per planning query, not once per search step.

method.name: _get_effects
method.description: Called during planning to replace [member effects] with a dictionary computed from the current situation.

method.name: _get_preconditions
method.description: Called during planning to replace [member preconditions] with a dictionary computed from the current situation.

method.name: _is_valid
method.description: Called during planning, and again right before the action starts, to decide whether it can be considered at all. Return [code]false[/code] for conditions that are awkward to express as facts, such as "a tree exists within range". An action that is not valid is left out of the search entirely.

method.name: _tick
method.description: Called every frame while the action runs. Return one of [constant STATUS_RUNNING], [constant STATUS_SUCCEEDED] or [constant STATUS_FAILED]. Returning [constant STATUS_FAILED] aborts the whole plan and makes the agent plan again.

method.name: apply_effects
method.description: Returns a copy of [param world_state] with this action's effects written into it. [param world_state] itself is left untouched.

method.name: check_preconditions
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if every precondition of this action holds in [param world_state].

method.name: enter
method.description: Runs [method _enter]. Called by [GoapAgent]; only call it directly when driving actions yourself.

method.name: exit
method.description: Runs [method _exit]. Called by [GoapAgent]; only call it directly when driving actions yourself.

method.name: get_effective_cost
method.description: Returns the cost the planner will use: the result of [method _get_cost] when it is overridden, otherwise [member cost].

method.name: get_effective_effects
method.description: Returns the effects the planner will use: the result of [method _get_effects] when it is overridden, otherwise [member effects].

method.name: get_effective_preconditions
method.description: Returns the preconditions the planner will use: the result of [method _get_preconditions] when it is overridden, otherwise [member preconditions].

method.name: is_valid
method.description: Returns the result of [method _is_valid], or [code]true[/code] when it is not overridden.

method.name: tick
method.description: Runs [method _tick], returning [constant STATUS_SUCCEEDED] when it is not overridden. Called by [GoapAgent]; only call it directly when driving actions yourself.

members.member: A name used for debugging and for inspecting plans. It has no effect on planning.

If [code]true[/code], [GoapAgent] writes this action's effects into [member GoapContext.world_state] as soon as it succeeds, so the world state follows the plan without extra bookkeeping. Set it to [code]false[/code] when the facts are derived from the game itself, for instance from an inventory the action already updated, and let the action or a sensor set them instead.

What using this action costs the planner, in arbitrary units. Among the plans that reach a goal, the one with the lowest total cost is chosen. Negative values are clamped to [code]0.0[/code]. Costs below [code]1.0[/code] can make the planner explore more nodes than it strictly needs to; they remain correct, only slower.
The facts the planner assumes will hold once this action has succeeded. An action with no effects is skipped, since it can never bring a goal closer.

The facts that must hold in [member GoapContext.world_state] before this action can run. They are checked during planning and again just before the action starts, so a plan built a moment ago is never executed against a world that has changed underneath it.

constants.constant: The action needs more time; it will be ticked again next frame.
The action is done. The agent applies its effects and moves to the next step of the plan.
The action could not be completed. The agent drops the whole plan and starts over.
